One of the main problems that websites like Voat have when it comes to monetization is that there is a lack of scarce resources. Everything, or almost everything is unlimited or very abundant: votes, commenting, creating a subverse, creating a new submission, etc.

However this makes monetization difficult. In order to fix this Voat could create a new, transferable and scarce resource. For example (name optional) "Golden Upvoats".

Golden Upvoats would be a scarce tranferable resources. This means that when you give someone a certain amount of golden upvoats you lose that same amount.

Golden upvoats could be used on voat as a way to distinguish and reward quality content but also to allow for the creation of local economies inside certain service oriented subverses that would certainly emerge.

Golden Upvoats would have a limited supply and they could be obtained, for example, on an open market in exchange for digital currency or for vanity profile items / icons / trading cards, etc.

Once in motion Voat itself has two excellent ways to monetize: 1. Take a fee for each transaction. 2. Create new vanity items that can be easily sold for golden upvoats.

Voat's monetization would be directly dependent on the size of its community and economy.

In comparison, Reddit Gold had several flaws that made it less than ideal:

  1. It was perishable. Although you could stack it up it always ends up disappearing.
  2. It was not transferable. Meaning that you could not pass it on to other users.
  3. It was not divisble. There was just one single reddit gold which cost about $5, making it very very unsuitable as a medium of exchange.

Those of you who've studied the properties of money will have noticed how bad reddit gold is/was in terms of economic potential. However, Voat could do things right and create a scarce resource to be used as medium of exchange and fuel local economies that'd have a lot of potential.
Idea to monetize Voat: create a scarce tranferable resource and allow local economies to emerge and flourish
